name: New York City
significance: Most populous city in the US. Major financial, cultural, and media center. Home of Wall Street, Broadway, UN HQ.

name: Los Angeles
significance: Second largest US city. Capital of the entertainment industry (Hollywood). Largest city in California.

name: Chicago
significance: Third largest US city. Major financial center, birthplace of skyscraper architecture, blues music capital.

name: Houston
significance: Fourth largest US city. Energy capital of the world, home of NASA Johnson Space Center, largest Texas city.

name: Phoenix
significance: Fifth largest US city. Capital of Arizona. Major Sun Belt metro.

name: Philadelphia

name: San Antonio
significance: Site of the Alamo, major Texas city. Seventh largest US city.

name: San Diego

name: Dallas

name: San Jose

name: Austin
significance: Texas state capital. Major tech hub (Tesla, Oracle, AMD). Live music capital of the world.

name: Boston

name: Seattle
significance: Pacific Northwest tech hub (Amazon, Microsoft HQ). Birthplace of grunge music.

name: Washington, D.C.
significance: Capital of the United States. Seat of federal government, White House, Capitol, Supreme Court.

name: Atlanta

name: Miami
significance: Major Southern hub. Gateway to Latin America, tourism capital, financial center.

name: Detroit

name: San Francisco
significance: Tech and finance hub. Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz. Silicon Valley adjacent.

name: Denver
significance: Mile High City. Capital of Colorado. Mountain west hub.

name: Las Vegas
significance: Entertainment capital of the world. Casinos, shows. Nevada gambling mecca.

name: Nashville
significance: Music City. Country music capital. Tennessee state capital.

name: Portland
significance: Pacific Northwest cultural hub. Progressive reputation, breweries.

name: New Orleans
significance: Birthplace of jazz music. Mardi Gras, French Quarter, Creole cuisine.

name: Memphis
significance: Birthplace of blues, soul, rock and roll. Beale Street, Graceland (Elvis Presley's home).

name: Orlando
significance: Theme park capital of the world. Walt Disney World, Universal Studios.

name: Cleveland
significance: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame. Major Great Lakes industrial city.

name: Pittsburgh
significance: Steel City. Carnegie Steel legacy. Three rivers confluence.

name: Cincinnati
significance: Queen City. Major 19th-century industrial hub on the Ohio River.

name: Minneapolis

name: Kansas City
significance: Jazz heritage, BBQ, fountains. Border city on Missouri River.

name: Indianapolis
significance: Crossroads of America. Indianapolis 500, capital of Indiana.

name: Columbus

name: Charlotte
significance: Second largest financial center in US (banking HQ). NASCAR hub.

name: Raleigh

name: Milwaukee
significance: Brewery town (Pabst, Schlitz, Miller). Great Lakes industrial city.

name: Salt Lake City
significance: Capital of Utah. Headquarters of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.

name: Birmingham
significance: Magic City. Major Southern industrial city, civil rights history.

name: Baton Rouge
significance: Capital of Louisiana. Mississippi River port, oil refining.

name: Anchorage
significance: Largest Alaska city. Northernmost major US city.

name: Honolulu
significance: Capital of Hawaii. Pacific hub, Pearl Harbor, Waikiki.

name: Tucson
significance: Second largest Arizona city. University of Arizona. Sonoran Desert.

name: Albuquerque
significance: Largest New Mexico city. Native American culture, film industry (Breaking Bad).

name: Omaha
significance: Midwestern hub. Berkshire Hathaway HQ (Warren Buffett).

name: Tulsa
significance: Oil capital of the world (historical). Art Deco architecture.

name: Wichita
significance: Air Capital of the World (aircraft manufacturing). Largest Kansas city.

name: St. Louis
significance: Gateway to the West. Gateway Arch, Anheuser-Busch HQ.

name: Baltimore
significance: Charm City. Major East Coast port. Johns Hopkins, Fort McHenry.

name: Hartford
significance: Insurance Capital of the World. Connecticut state capital. Mark Twain's home.

name: Statue of Liberty
significance: Iconic symbol of freedom and democracy. Gift from France. Located on Liberty Island in New York Harbor. UNESCO World Heritage Site.

name: Mount Rushmore
significance: Sculpture of US presidents Washington, Jefferson, T. Roosevelt, and Lincoln. National memorial in the Black Hills.

name: Golden Gate Bridge
significance: Iconic suspension bridge in San Francisco. Symbol of the city and engineering marvel.

name: White House
significance: Official residence and workplace of the US President. Located in Washington DC.

name: United States Capitol
significance: Meeting place of the US Congress. Iconic neoclassical building with iconic dome.

name: Lincoln Memorial
significance: Tribute to Abraham Lincoln. Site of Martin Luther King Jr.'s I Have a Dream speech.

name: Washington Monument
significance: Obelisk honoring George Washington. Tallest structure in DC. Iconic skyline element.

name: Empire State Building
significance: Iconic Art Deco skyscraper in NYC. Famous for King Kong scene. Once world's tallest building.

name: Central Park
significance: Iconic urban park in Manhattan. Designed by Frederick Law Olmsted. 843 acres.

name: Hollywood Sign
significance: Iconic symbol of the American film industry, located in the Hollywood Hills.

name: Golden Gate Park
significance: Large urban park in San Francisco. Houses the de Young Museum and California Academy of Sciences.

name: Alcatraz Island
significance: Former federal prison on island in San Francisco Bay. Famous escape attempts. Now a national park.

name: Grand Canyon
significance: Massive natural canyon carved by the Colorado River. UNESCO World Heritage Site. One of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World.

name: Yellowstone National Park
significance: First national park in the world. Famous for geysers (Old Faithful), wildlife, and geothermal features.

name: Yosemite National Park
significance: Iconic national park known for granite cliffs (El Capitan, Half Dome), waterfalls, giant sequoias.

name: Yellowstone National Park (Wyoming)
significance: See Yellowstone.

name: Mount Rushmore National Memorial
significance: See Mount Rushmore.

name: Independence Hall

name: Liberty Bell
significance: Iconic symbol of American independence. Cracked bell, displayed in Philadelphia.

name: Alamo
significance: Mission and fortress in San Antonio. Site of the 1836 battle for Texas independence.

name: Pearl Harbor
significance: Site of the December 7, 1941 attack that brought the US into World War II.

name: Graceland
significance: Mansion in Memphis, home of Elvis Presley. Most visited private residence in the US.

name: Mount Vernon
significance: George Washington's plantation estate on the Potomac River. Historic house museum.

name: Independence National Historical Park
significance: Preserves sites related to American Revolution including Independence Hall and Liberty Bell.

name: Fenway Park
significance: Oldest Major League Baseball stadium in use. Home of the Boston Red Sox.

name: Madison Square Garden

name: Times Square
significance: Iconic commercial intersection in Midtown Manhattan. New Year's Eve ball drop.

name: Brooklyn Bridge
significance: Iconic suspension bridge connecting Manhattan and Brooklyn across the East River.

name: Wall Street
significance: Famous street in Lower Manhattan. Heart of global finance. New York Stock Exchange.

name: Pentagon
significance: Headquarters of the US Department of Defense. Largest office building in the world by floor area.

name: Hoover Dam
significance: Major concrete arch-gravity dam on the Colorado River, on the Nevada-Arizona border.

name: Walt Disney World
significance: Iconic theme park resort near Orlando. Magic Kingdom, EPCOT, Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom.

name: Disneyland
significance: Original Disney theme park in Anaheim, California. Opened by Walt Disney himself.

name: Kennedy Space Center

name: Johnson Space Center
significance: NASA's primary astronaut training facility and mission control in Houston.

name: Smithsonian Institution
significance: Largest museum complex in the world, including National Museum of American History.

name: Getty Center
significance: Art museum in Los Angeles founded by J. Paul Getty. Houses European paintings and photography.

name: Metropolitan Museum of Art
significance: The Met. Largest art museum in the US, on the east side of Central Park.

name: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame

name: Pro Football Hall of Fame

name: Baseball Hall of Fame
